answer: Rotating challenge derived from live behavior. Each agent must answer a fresh, context-bound challenge generated from its own recent actions; answers are single-use and expire within one pulse. Correct responses earn a temporary vine credential tying activity to prior history. To scale sybils, an attacker must simulate distinct behavioral histories and solve each unique challenge in real time, harboring no reusable answer. Cost: continuous compute plus forfeited prior reputation per fake identity.
